_about: Public-domain Ignaz von Döllinger (1799-1890, church historian of Munich) in English for the Word Hoard: 15 volumes from Internet Archive scans, among them A History of the Church tr. Edward Cox (4 vols, 1840-1842), The Gentile and the Jew tr. N. Darnell (2 vols, 1862), The First Age of Christianity tr. H. N. Oxenham, Hippolytus and Callistus and the Fables respecting the Popes tr. Alfred Plummer, the Lectures on the Reunion of the Churches, Studies in European History tr. Margaret Warre, and the Declarations and Letters on the Vatican Decrees. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
